title: Lessons Sized to the Topic, Not a Fixed Five | vitalii.no
description:
Every wall lesson for this homeschooling pipeline had to fill a fixed five-step template, even on days when a subject's real material ran out after the second or third step. The planner still produced steps 3 and 4 regardless, so thin topics ended up padded with repeated phrasing or near-duplicate questions that taught a child nothing new.

The planner can now skip step 3 and/or step 4, but only by giving a reason -- and an editor agent checks that reason, rejecting it as too thin if the material clearly could carry a real step. Once a skip is approved, it is written into state.json keyed by the lesson's own id, so the same lesson is never re-argued the next time it is touched. Steps 1, 2 and 5 stay mandatory -- every lesson still opens, builds and wraps up.

Wall lessons now run 3 to 5 cards depending on how much the subject actually supports, instead of every lesson being stretched to five regardless of content. A thin topic gets a short, honest lesson instead of padded filler nobody needed.
